summary: Frontend-only browser testing covered landing, restaurant, NGO, admin, persistence, theme/language, responsive mobile navigation, and test IDs. Core flows passed; billing plan action toast did not appear.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the Switch to Basic button did not produce the expected success toast (Plan switched to Basic).

action_items: Verify the Billing Switch to Basic action is wired to a visible Sonner toast and retest it.
critical_code_review_comments: All tested data is intentionally MOCKED local React state/localStorage; there is no real API or authentication integration.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed local waste log (Persistence Check, 4 kg) during browser testing; it is stored in the browser localStorage mock.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing, restaurant overview/log/marketplace/billing navigation, local persistence, NGO claim/My claims, admin queue/search, theme/language, mobile overflow/sidebar, and unique visible data-testid checks passed. Billing toast needs retest.

rca of the issue: Reproduction: enter Restaurant demo, open Billing, click [data-testid="switch-basic-button"], wait briefly, and look for exact text 'Plan switched to Basic'. The button click completed but no visible toast was found. BillingPage calls toast.success, so inspect Sonner mounting/visibility or whether this action is being intercepted.
